title: Joining a Game
goal: Explore friendly ways to join others in play.
steps: Talk about why this response works well.
parent_tips: Discuss how different responses make people feel.
There is no right/wrong shaming—just exploring options.

content.scenario: Your friends are building a tall block tower. You want to join them.

options.text: Walk up, smile, and ask: 'Can I help build the tower?'
Grab some blocks and knock it down.
options.explanation: Might upset your friends and stop the game.

options.text: Stand quietly and watch from far away.
options.explanation: Safe, but makes it hard for friends to know you want to play.

strengths_message: Thoughtful choice! Knowing how to join in makes playtime fun for everyone.
